name: Lime Light
source:
Lia's mother who was aiming for prima donna suddenly collapsed from illness and now Lia has to substitute for her. By a twist of fortune Lia's doll Tia arises to help Lia with this goal.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
莉娅的母亲曾以成为首席女歌手为目标，却突然因病倒下，莉娅只好代替母亲登台。命运的转折让莉娅的玩偶蒂娅醒来，帮助她实现目标。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
